dct_creator_sm: Neil Nevitte (University of Toronto, University of Calgary).
dct_description_sm: The 1997 Canadian Election Survey (CES) included three survey components. The Campaign-Period Survey (CPS) was completed in the 36 days between the election call, on April 27th, and the last day of the campaign, June 1st. The Post-Election Survey (PES) was completed with respondents to the CPS in the eight weeks after the June 2nd election. The Mailback Survey (MBS) was completed with respondents to the PES from June 19 to October 24, 1997.
